name: Verdant Salve
description: Spread a green salve of living force over an ally's soul wound and feel the edges draw together.

name: Vital Reading
description: Read the flow of life and soul together in a patient to learn which of the two is the weaker.

name: Sapling Shell
description: Grow a slender shell of living force about a hurt ally that flexes under a blow.

name: Greening Mend
description: Coax new green growth across the torn places of an ally's soul until the wound is hidden.

name: Sap Cleansing
description: Run rising sap through an ally's soul and body to flush out poison and taint together.

name: Vital Vigor
description: Raise an ally's vitality and soul strength together so body and will rise to the same height.

name: Verdant Rebuild
description: Raise a ruined soul and the flesh around it in one slow growth of living force.

name: Quickening Recall
description: Quicken the heart and the soul of a newly stopped ally in the same instant and hold them together.

name: Evergreen Restoration
description: Restore a gravely hurt ally with a healing that stays green and never fades from the soul.

name: Living Soulbloom
description: streams: Healing Soul + Life; unfold a flower of soul and living force over an ally and mend body and spirit as one.

name: Channel Salve
description: Run a salve of soul and qi together along the meridians of an ally to ease a bruised soul.

name: Meridian Reading
description: Read the meridians and the soul of a patient together and find where the two are out of step.

name: Wrapped Shell
description: Wrap a patient in a shell of soul force carried on a thin sheet of qi.

name: Unison Cheer
description: Breathe in unison with an ally and carry soul force along the breath until the ally's qi steadies.

name: Dantian Mending
description: Mend the dantian of a patient from within by pouring soul force into the cracked seat of qi.

name: Channel Cleansing
description: Clear the blocked channels of a patient with soul force and carry out the backlash of a failed breakthrough.

name: Ember Fortitude
description: Fan the inner ember of an ally with soul force until qi and will burn as one.

name: Meridian Easing
description: Smooth the strained meridians of an ally with a warm flow of soul and qi in step.

name: Unity Restoration
description: Restore an ally's soul and qi at once with one flow in which neither outruns the other.

name: Unity Recall
description: Call a newly stopped ally's soul and qi back together before the two can part for good.

name: Imprinted Renewal
description: Imprint the healer's soul force on an ally's qi so the renewal runs through every channel.

name: Imprinted Qi
description: streams: Healing Soul + Qi; breathe out qi that carries the soul in every thread and heals body and soul at once.

name: Flowering Salve
description: Dab a salve of budding force on a soul wound and watch it flower closed in the ally.

name: Pollen Reading
description: Scatter fine motes of force over a patient and read which of them cling to the wounds.

name: Blossom Shell
description: Fold a shell of closed petals of force around a patient that opens only to the healer's hand.

name: Bloom Cheer
description: Coax a tired ally's will into bloom with a warm slow feeding of soul force.

name: Petal Mending
description: Lay overlapping petals of living force over a wide soul wound until it is wholly covered.

name: Blight Unmaking
description: Unmake a blight that feeds on an ally's soul and body by cutting it from its root.

name: Rootstrong Vigor
description: Set the roots of an ally's will deep in living force so no storm can pull them out.

name: Seedling Soothing
description: Soothe a newly wounded soul as one tends a seedling with water and light.

name: Canopy Rebuild
description: Raise a broad canopy of living force over a ruined soul and let it regrow beneath.

name: Rebloom Recall
description: Make the cut flower of a newly stopped ally's soul rebloom on the stem of the body.

name: Taproot Restoration
description: Send a taproot of force down to the base of an ally's soul and draw fresh strength up.

name: Perennial Renewal
description: Renew a gravely harmed ally with a growth that returns each season and never fails.

name: Soulbloom Genesis
description: streams: Healing Soul + Life; seed a new flowering of soul and body in an ally's emptied core and let it grow.

name: Undying Blossom
description: streams: Healing Soul + Life; plant a blossom of soul and living force in a newly stopped ally that will not wither.
